title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.12.1 publishes GPT Image 2.5 support
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: Image-generation capability is now entering the official JavaScript SDK surface, while the release pipeline also records a concrete edge-runtime regression gate.
actionable_takeaway: Pin the SDK, test image options on Node and Cloudflare-like runtimes, and treat 7.12.0 as skipped for npm upgrade paths.

title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.10.0 adds GPT Image 2.5 and key-expiration fields
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: Python automation can now reason about both multimodal image generation options and expiring service-account credentials from typed SDK fields.
actionable_takeaway: Add expiry readback to service-account receipts and run a fixed image-generation smoke before upgrading production agents.

title: OpenAI Java SDK 4.60.0 adds GPT Image 2.5 support
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: The image and diagnostics surface is becoming cross-language rather than a one-SDK experiment.
actionable_takeaway: Keep a per-language parity matrix for image options, cache diagnostics, key expiry, and function-call streaming fields.

title: Agents Python 0.22.1 adds web-search images and server-wide MCP guardrails
author: OpenAI Agents SDK contributors
why_it_matters: The SDK is moving from single-agent execution toward tool-server policy, richer search artifacts, and auditable runtime isolation.
actionable_takeaway: Define guardrail messages per tool server, classify image search outputs before reuse, and label sandbox containers for cleanup and receipts.

title: Codex 0.154.0-alpha.8 appears without behavioral notes
author: OpenAI / GitHub
why_it_matters: Release cadence is visible, but there is still no feature or fix evidence to justify changing the stable lane.
actionable_takeaway: Keep 0.154.0 alpha isolated and require release-body evidence plus a fixed smoke suite before any default change.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.84-3 fixes MCP OAuth startup and copy exports
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: MCP startup and transcript export are both evidence-chain details for long agent sessions.
actionable_takeaway: After upgrading, test OAuth MCP startup from a cold session and verify copied transcripts include completion-state messages.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.84-2 ships Vim mode and records sandbox blocks
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The CLI is making both human editing ergonomics and sandbox escalation evidence more explicit.
actionable_takeaway: Add blocked-access logs, hook-policy state, and exact resume IDs to CLI run receipts before approving sandbox bypasses.

title: GHES 3.22 brings Copilot CLI to disconnected enterprise environments
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Agentic coding is no longer only a cloud-connected workflow; enterprise provider setup, credentials, and preview status become first-class gates.
actionable_takeaway: For GHES use, record model-provider config, GHES credential source, air-gap boundary, preview status, and rollback owner.

title: Dependabot can read GitHub-hosted private registries without PATs
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Dependency automation can drop long-lived PATs, but fallback authentication and registry routing need explicit verification.
actionable_takeaway: Remove PAT entries only after readback of package Actions access, Dependabot success, and normal registry precedence.

title: GitHub launches help.github.com with Copilot-powered search
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Support triage can start from a single public entry point before account-specific escalation.
actionable_takeaway: Use help.github.com for public triage, then separately record account state and rollout availability before acting on support-sensitive cases.

title: GitHub Copilot weekly release bundles model choice with agent-session management
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Agent workflows are becoming multi-session, multi-root, and merge-oriented instead of only prompt-in-editor interactions.
actionable_takeaway: Track model availability, content exclusions, session hierarchy, merge readiness, and multi-root folder boundaries as separate states.

title: GPT-6 Astra is available across Copilot surfaces with gradual rollout
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: A model announcement now affects desktop, CLI, cloud agent, mobile, and IDE surfaces, but actual access still depends on rollout and policy.
actionable_takeaway: Do not assume availability from the headline; read back model picker state per surface and record plan, policy, and observed model.
